levels.title: First Day on the Job
levels.task: Your supervisor at Stellar Sound wants a quick look at the latest chart. She asks you to open the whole top_songs table. Show every column with SELECT * FROM top_songs.
levels.successMessage: Great job! You showed the full chart table.

levels.title: Select Specific Column
levels.task: You are asked to help the playlist team at Stellar Sound. They want all song titles in alphabetical order so the team can scan ideas fast. Return track_name in alphabetical order.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name FROM top_songs ORDER BY track_name;
levels.hintMessage: Use SELECT track_name FROM top_songs ORDER BY track_name.
levels.successMessage: Great! The team can read the titles in alphabetical order.

levels.title: Select Distinct
levels.task: The A&R team at Stellar Sound finds new artists. They want a list of artists on the Top 50 chart with no repeats—each name once. Return column artist, sorted alphabetically by artist.
levels.solution: SELECT DISTINCT artist FROM top_songs ORDER BY artist;
levels.hintMessage: Use DISTINCT artist and ORDER BY artist so the list order is the same every time.
levels.successMessage: Nice work! The A&R team has a clean artist list.

levels.title: Sorting with ORDER BY
levels.task: Your boss is curious about how release timing affects popularity. She asks you to organize the songs by release date so she can look for trends. Provide a list that shows the most recent release dates first.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, release_date FROM top_songs ORDER BY release_date DESC;
levels.hintMessage: Use columns in this order: track_name, artist, release_date. Then ORDER BY release_date DESC.
levels.successMessage: Great work! Your boss can now see which songs are newest first.

levels.title: Select with ORDER BY
levels.task: Another intern at Stellar Sound is building an artist spotlight wall. She wants to see only the track_name and artist. Sort by artist and track_name.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist FROM top_songs ORDER BY artist, track_name;
levels.hintMessage: SELECT track_name, artist then ORDER BY artist, track_name so the order is the same every time.
levels.successMessage: Great! Your intern can build the wall with this sorted list.
